header.title: About UniGuide Pakistan
header.description: Pakistan's national intelligence platform for university discovery, verified merit calculations, and transparent higher education opportunities.

narrative.heading: Eliminating the information asymmetry that prevents talented Pakistani students from reaching their potential.
narrative.paragraph_1: Every year, over 1.2 million Pakistani students complete their Intermediate (HSSC / FSc / FA / ICS) and Cambridge A-Levels. Navigating the decentralized admissions landscape across 240+ institutions—each with unique entry tests, divergent aggregate weightage formulas, unpublished closing cutoffs, and confusing fee schedules—leads to missed deadlines, wasted application fees, and unfulfilled aspirations.
narrative.paragraph_2: UniGuide Pakistan was established to provide a unified, authentic, and completely free national gateway. We do not sell promotional placements or accept paid ranking manipulations. Every statistic, fee figure, and merit formula is directly cross-referenced against official provincial assembly charters and gazetted university circulars.

protocol.title: The UniGuide Zero-Hallucination & Transparency Protocol
protocol.description: We operate with rigorous data standards to ensure candidate safety across Punjab and Islamabad.
protocol.step_1_desc: An institution is only cataloged once verified against the official gazette of Pakistan or provincial assembly charter. Unaccredited sub-campuses are flagged with public warning alerts.
protocol.step_2_desc: All tuition, admission, and hostel charges are extracted directly from institutional fee circulars signed by the University Treasurer or Registrar.
protocol.step_3_desc: Admission deadlines and entry test dates are monitored continuously via automated ingestion pipelines and direct institutional registrar feeds.
